visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four performers stand on a stage in front of a large LED screen displaying blue stars and cosmic patterns. On the far left, a man in a white shirt and pants, wearing sunglasses, holds a golden saxophone (labeled '1'). To his right, a woman in a long red satin dress holds a microphone and appears to be singing with expressive mouth movements (labeled '2'). Behind her, a man in a denim jacket and white shirt stands at a keyboard (labeled '3'). On the far right, a woman in a light blue long-sleeve crop top and navy blue wide-leg pants plays a silver flute (labeled '4'). (2) The camera is static in a medium full shot, showing the ensemble's coordinated movements as they sway and perform. The lighting is bright and uniform, characteristic of an indoor event space. The singer in red gestures with her hands while the flutist moves rhythmically with her instrument. (3) The music stops, and the flutist (performer 4) lowers her instrument, smiles widely at the camera, and gives a thumbs up while pointing to herself. The singer (performer 2) turns toward her, laughing and confirming the flutist's role in the performance. The background screen continues to display moving light patterns.

Simultaneously, a solo flute plays a counter-melody with sharp, clean transients and a bright spectral centroid. The mix is professionally balanced, emphasizing the flute and vocals. (2) The pop arrangement continues with consistent intensity and tempo. The flute dominates the high-frequency range, while the percussion provides a stable rhythmic floor. There is no speech, only the singing and instrumental layers. (3) The music abruptly cuts to near-silence. A brief burst of laughter and casual female chatter is heard, indicating a live environment reveal. The acoustic tone shifts from the polished studio mix of the music to a natural indoor room tone with a slightly higher noise floor.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is designed as an interactive social media challenge, inviting viewers to identify which performer is actually playing their instrument live versus miming to a backing track.
